values.note: Full service (water, sewer, power) C$55 a day, C$325 a week; unserviced or tent C$55 a day. Monthly year-round C$1,000 (30-amp) / C$1,300 (50-amp). Pets C$2 each a day; dump station C$15 + GST.
No reservations; call the store (9 AM-9 PM) to check what is open that day and check in there.

note: Private travel-stop campground with a store, fuel and liquor store on Hwy 1A ~13 km west of Cochrane near Ghost Lake; fire pit and picnic table at each site, showers are free, a trail leads down to Spencer's Creek. One unit per site. --Claude
